title: ⏰ Daily Routine (распорядок дня) & Adverbs of frequency

days.title: Day 1: Morning Routine (Утро)
days.description: Что мы делаем утром? Учим глаголы для утренних действий

grammar.title: Adverbs of frequency (наречия частотности)
grammar.rule:
📘 **Наречия частотности показывают, как часто мы что-то делаем**:

✅ **always** — всегда (100%)
✅ **usually** — обычно (80-90%)
✅ **often** — часто (60-70%)
✅ **sometimes** — иногда (30-40%)
✅ **never** — никогда (0%)

📝 **Где ставить в предложении**:
1️⃣ После глагола to be: I **am always** late.
2️⃣ Перед смысловым глаголом: I **usually** get up at 7.

🎯 **Мем**: My alarm clock **always** rings. I **never** want to get up. But I **always** do it... eventually. ⏰😴

vocabulary.example: I wake up at 7 am every day.
vocabulary.context_example: Я просыпаюсь в 7 утра каждый день.

vocabulary.example: I always have a shower in the morning.
I get dressed after my shower.
I brush my teeth twice a day.
vocabulary.context_example: Я чищу зубы два раза в день.

vocabulary.example: I go to school at 8 am.
vocabulary.context_example: Я иду в школу в 8 утра.

days.title: Day 2: Afternoon and Evening Routine
days.description: Что мы делаем днём и вечером? Учим глаголы для дневных и вечерних действий

grammar.title: Adverbs of frequency — практика
grammar.rule:
📘 **Продолжаем учить наречия частотности**:

✅ **always** — всегда
✅ **usually** — обычно
✅ **often** — часто
✅ **sometimes** — иногда
✅ **never** — никогда

📝 **Помни**:
Наречия частотности ставятся ПЕРЕД основным глаголом.

✅ I **sometimes** play video games after school.
✅ She **always** does her homework.
❌ I play sometimes video games. (неправильно!)

vocabulary.example: I do my homework after school.
vocabulary.context_example: Я делаю домашнее задание после школы.

vocabulary.example: I sometimes watch TikTok before bed.
vocabulary.context_example: Я иногда смотрю TikTok перед сном.

vocabulary.example: I relax on the sofa after dinner.
vocabulary.context_example: Я отдыхаю на диване после ужина.

vocabulary.example: I go to bed at 10 pm.

exercises.question: What do you do after school? 📚
exercises.explanation: Most students do homework after school! 📚

exercises.question: I ___ (usually / never) watch TikTok. My phone is always in my hand! 📱
exercises.explanation: Many teenagers USUALLY watch TikTok! 📱

exercises.question: You have dinner in the morning.
exercises.explanation: Dinner is in the evening, not in the morning! 🍽️

exercises.explanation: Going to bed at midnight is too late for most students! 😴

exercises.question: I watch sometimes TV in the evening.
exercises.correct: I sometimes watch TV in the evening.
accept: I sometimes watch TV in the evening
Sometimes I watch TV in the evening
exercises.explanation: Adverbs of frequency go BEFORE the main verb: sometimes watch! 📺

days.title: Day 3: Daily Routine of a Blogger

grammar.title: Telling the time (спрашиваем и говорим время)
grammar.rule:
📘 **Как спросить время**:
❓ What time is it? — Который час?
❓ Have you got the time? — Вы не скажете, который час?

📝 **Как отвечать**:
⏰ **It's ... o'clock.** — Ровно ... часов.
⏰ **It's half past ...** — Половина ...
⏰ **It's quarter past ...** — Четверть ...
⏰ **It's quarter to ...** — Без четверти ...

🎯 **Мем**:
❓ 'What time is it?'
⏰ 'It's time to stop scrolling TikTok and go to sleep!' 😅

vocabulary.example: I check my phone every 5 minutes.
I take photos for my Instagram.
I edit videos for my YouTube channel.
vocabulary.context_example: Я монтирую видео для своего YouTube-канала.

vocabulary.example: I record videos in the morning.
I check my channel stats every day.
vocabulary.context_example: Я проверяю статистику канала каждый день.

vocabulary.example: I reply to comments on my posts.
vocabulary.context_example: Я отвечаю на комментарии под своими постами.

days.title: Day 4: Reading — A Day in the Life of a Famous Blogger
days.description: Читаем о распорядке дня известного блогера

grammar.title: Чтение и понимание текста
grammar.rule:
📚 **Стратегия чтения**:
1️⃣ Прочитай текст целиком, чтобы понять общий смысл.
2️⃣ Найди действия блогера в разное время дня.
3️⃣ Прочитай вопросы и найди ответы в тексте.

💡 **Совет**: Обрати внимание на наречия частотности (always, usually, sometimes, never)!

exercises.question: What time does Dima wake up? ⏰
exercises.explanation: Dima wakes up at 8 am. Он блогер, а не ранняя пташка! 😅
exercises.readingText:
🌟 A DAY IN THE LIFE OF A FAMOUS BLOGGER 🌟

Meet Dima — he's a popular blogger from Russia. He has got 2 million subscribers on YouTube and 1 million followers on TikTok. Let's see what his daily routine looks like!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⏰ 8:00 AM — WAKE UP
Dima wakes up at 8 am. He doesn't like mornings, but he always gets up. He checks his phone immediately — 50 new notifications! 'The life of a blogger is hard,' he says. 😅

🚿 8:15 AM — SHOWER & GET DRESSED
He always has a shower and gets dressed. He usually wears a hoodie and jeans. 'Comfort is key!'

🍳 8:30 AM — BREAKFAST
Dima has breakfast — usually cereal or a sandwich. He sometimes drinks coffee. 'I can't function without coffee!' ☕

📹 9:30 AM — RECORD VIDEOS
The best time to record videos is in the morning. Dima often records 2-3 videos in one day. 'Sometimes I record videos and then I edit them in the afternoon.'

💻 1:00 PM — EDIT VIDEOS
Dima edits videos for 2-3 hours. He often uses CapCut. 'Editing takes forever, but it's worth it!'

📊 4:00 PM — CHECK STATS
He checks his channel stats. 'The numbers tell me what content works best.'

🍽️ 6:00 PM — DINNER
Dima has dinner with his family. 'Family time is important!'

📱 7:00 PM — REPLY TO COMMENTS
He replies to comments and talks to fans. 'My fans are the best!'

🎮 9:00 PM — FREE TIME
Dima relaxes. He sometimes plays video games or watches Netflix. 'I need to disconnect from work.'

🛌 12:00 AM — GO TO BED
Dima goes to bed at midnight. 'I try to sleep earlier, but I never can!' 😴

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💭 DIMA'S TIP FOR SUCCESS:
'Be consistent! Post every day, even if you don't feel like it. Your audience will appreciate it!' 💪

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

exercises.explanation: Dima says: 'I usually wear a hoodie and jeans. Comfort is key!'

exercises.explanation: Dima goes to bed at midnight (12 am). 'I try to sleep earlier, but I never can!'

days.title: Day 5: My Daily Routine
days.description: Учимся говорить о своём распорядке дня

grammar.title: Present Simple + Adverbs of frequency
grammar.rule:
📘 **Как говорить о своём распорядке дня**:

1️⃣ Используй Present Simple для действий, которые повторяются каждый день.
2️⃣ Добавляй наречия частотности (always, usually, sometimes, never).
3️⃣ Используй выражения времени: in the morning, after school, at 7 o'clock.

🎯 **Структура**:
✅ I **always** get up at 7 am.
✅ I **usually** have breakfast at 7:30.
✅ I **sometimes** watch YouTube before bed.
✅ I **never** skip breakfast!

exercises.question: I ___ get up early. I love sleeping! 😴
exercises.explanation: If you love sleeping, you NEVER get up early! 😴

exercises.question: I ___ (always / never) do my homework. I want to get good grades! 📚
exercises.explanation: If you want good grades, you ALWAYS do your homework! 📚

exercises.question: 'Usually' means 100% of the time.
exercises.explanation: Usually means 80-90% of the time. Always means 100%! 🔢

exercises.question: I ___ (sometimes / never) eat pizza for breakfast. It's a bit weird! 🍕
exercises.explanation: Eating pizza for breakfast is weird, but SOMETIMES it happens! 🍕

exercises.question: I never am late for school.
exercises.correct: I am never late for school.
accept: I am never late for school
exercises.explanation: With 'am/is/are', the adverb goes AFTER the verb: am never! ⏰

days.title: Day 6: Writing — My Daily Routine
days.description: Пишем текст о своём распорядке дня

grammar.title: Повторение: распорядок дня
grammar.rule:
📚 **План для письма**:

1️⃣ Что ты делаешь утром? (wake up, get up, have breakfast)
2️⃣ Что ты делаешь днём? (go to school, do homework, have lunch)
3️⃣ Что ты делаешь вечером? (have dinner, relax, go to bed)
4️⃣ Используй наречия частотности (always, usually, sometimes, never)
5️⃣ Используй выражения времени (at 7 am, in the morning, after school)

🎯 **Пример**:
I always wake up at 7 am. I usually have breakfast at 7:30. I go to school at 8 am. After school, I do my homework. In the evening, I watch TikTok and relax. I go to bed at 10 pm.

exercises.explanation: Напиши, как часто ты просыпаешься в 7 утра! ⏰

exercises.question: I have breakfast at ___ am. (напиши время)
exercises.explanation: Во сколько ты завтракаешь? 🍳

exercises.explanation: Во сколько ты идёшь в школу? 🚌

exercises.question: After school, I ___ my homework. (do / play)
exercises.explanation: Do homework — делать уроки! 📚

exercises.question: I go to bed at ___ pm. (напиши время)
exercises.explanation: Во сколько ты ложишься спать? 🛌
